grid.title: User Management

dialog.subtitle: Manage account, profile and permission information in a single step.
dialog.warehousesHint: If warehouses are selected, the user can only perform goods receipt in the selected warehouses. If none are selected, all warehouses are open. The Admin role always sees all warehouses.
dialog.superadminNotice: The primary system user's username, role and active status cannot be changed for security reasons.
dialog.activeUserHint: Allow the user to sign in to the system.

deactivateDialog.title: Deactivate user
deactivateDialog.description: {{username}} will no longer be able to sign in. Historical records will be preserved.

import.title: Add Users via Excel
import.description: Upload the approved template to create new user records in bulk.
import.warningText: Existing users are not updated, deactivated or deleted. If a username or email already exists, that row is skipped unchanged.
import.step1Description: Fill in the "Users" sheet without changing the headers or column order.
import.multiGroupDescriptionPrefix: The permission groups active at download time are read from the API and each is added as a separate
import.multiGroupHintPrefix: To assign the same user to multiple groups, select
import.multiGroupHintSuffix: in each relevant group column. You can leave unselected ones blank or false.
import.groupsSheetNote: The "Permission Groups" sheet also contains the ID, name and description of the groups active at download time.

errors.invalidExtension: Only Excel files with the .xlsx extension can be uploaded.
errors.fileTooLarge: The Excel file can be at most 5 MB.
